items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: But, uh, oh, and I don't know. Then there was a guy in the Castle Oma band, I think his name was Pat Sullivan?

ctx.x: Yeah, well, of course, if the people knew him beforehand, it never started arranging. That's what I believe, yes. Yeah, well, Don Redman was doing his arrangements for him before that.
But, uh, oh, and I don't know. Then there was a guy in the Castle Oma band, I think his name was Pat Sullivan? No, Pat… The Tenor Club?
